title: Year 11 Biology Module 3 – Biological Diversity
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Biology Module 3. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.prompt: What term describes a living environmental factor that affects an organism?

What type of adaptation involves an action such as migration?
What word describes how well an organism survives and reproduces in its environment?

Which scientist independently developed a theory of natural selection similar to Darwin's?

What is the formation of a new species called?
